concepts.def: Holiday vocab: la playa (beach), el extranjero (abroad), el alojamiento (accommodation), hacer la maleta (to pack).
Preterite for completed trips: fui (I went), visité (I visited), lo pasé genial (I had a great time).
Technology: el móvil (mobile phone), descargar (to download), las redes sociales (social media), en línea (online).
Environment: la contaminación (pollution), reciclar (to recycle), el cambio climático (climate change).
Near-future plans with ir a + infinitive: Este verano voy a viajar a España (This summer I'm going to travel to Spain).
Communication verbs: mandar mensajes (send messages), recibir (to receive), llamar (to call), charlar (to chat).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us — a core area of GCSE Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
